problem.title: Count Distinct Elements After Updates
problem.problemStatement: Given an initial array and a sequence of update queries, replace the value at the specified index after each query and report the number of distinct elements currently present.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and Q. • Second line contains N integers. • Next Q lines contain Index and NewValue.
problem.output: Print the number of distinct elements after each update.
